Sandbox_ViewDoctor: ViewDoctor | Health Overhaul for Project Zomboid/Viewpoint
Sandbox_ViewDoctor_Enabled_tooltip: Treating wounds starts a minigame first. Turn off to use the vanilla actions.
Sandbox_ViewDoctor_Difficulty_tooltip: How small the targets are. First Aid skill makes every level easier.
Sandbox_ViewDoctor_TimeLimit_tooltip: How long you get before the minigame ends with whatever you managed. Sawing and stitching get 30%% more.
Sandbox_ViewDoctor_QualityEffects_toolti: Clean work hurts less, heals faster, stops bleeding and rarely infects. Sloppy work hurts more, heals slower, can keep bleeding, often infects and can leave glass or a bullet behind.
Sandbox_ViewDoctor_BotchPenalty_tooltip: A botched minigame cancels the treatment, adds pain and can reopen bleeding.
Sandbox_ViewDoctor_InstantOnServer_toolt: Multiplayer only. Off: after the minigame the normal treatment time still plays. On: the treatment finishes the moment the minigame does. Risky: the server trusts each player's game, so a modified client could skip treatment times. Single player is always instant.
Sandbox_ViewDoctor_Undress_tooltip: Before treating yourself, your character takes off clothing that covers the wound and puts it back on afterwards.
